title: Remembering Uncommemorated Genocides & Holocausts
subtitle: A sub-archive within The Anarchive
abstract: A dedicated sub-archive within The GSS Anarchive: interactive data anarchives of the genocides, holocausts, and structural atrocities that mainstream memory refuses to keep. Curated from the research of Dr. Gideon Polya and other dissenting scholars, and hand-authored GSS counter-archives. Five entries now open: the Muslim Holocaust / Muslim Genocide (post-9/11, 32M avoidable deaths across 20 countries); the Aboriginal Genocide in Australia (1788 to present, ongoing); The Unwritten Ledger (caste, atrocity and the record in the Indian subcontinent); The ISN Registry (Guantánamo Bay, 780 numbers, 24 years); and The Paper Trail (Abu Ghraib and the chain of authorisation). Every entry is a full data page with chapters, charts, timelines, voices, and sources.
